mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_message WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_message (merchant_id, message_type, title, content, related_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{messageType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_message SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
